Just Call · advice with a LAiDIES twist

Dream Phone

Remember Dream Phone—that incredible game from the ’90s where you had to figure out your secret crush? We do too. And we brought it back, but this time with a LAiDIES twist! Use Just Call to get fun advice from someone who would have written something way better than “Have a great summer!” (brutal) in your high school yearbook.

The full game, for practising how to spot and correct AI hallucinations, is still in development.
